gaps.reason: No public dated calendar — events are announced ad hoc on Instagram/Facebook rather than a searchable calendar.

Main competition calendar is gated behind the member-only portal and isn't publicly indexed — only the public Summer Camp dates could be included. Log in to crownriding.co.uk/member-portal yourself and send over any dates to add.

No single published calendar or discoverable venue page -- RG Equine Training's clinics there are tracked manually (found via MyRidingLife's own event search, not a scrapable venue link), but other instructors' activity at this venue isn't covered.
